entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Mukesh Kumar Sinha
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Shantanu Kumar

======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Arvind Srivastava
 Oral Order
2 21-07-2023
1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned A.P.P. for the State.
2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Ara Town P.S. Case No. 997 of 2022 registered under Sections 409/420/467/471 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that similarly situated co-accused has already been allowed bail by a Bench of this Court vide order dated 06.02.2023 passed in Cr.
Misc. No. 60056 of 2022 4.

Having considered the above facts and circumstances of the case, let the above named petitioner be released on bail, in the event of arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of four weeks from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (ten thousand) with two Patna High Court CR.
MISC . No.29415 of 2023(2) dt.21-07-2023 sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of C.J.M., Ara, Bhojpur in connection with Ara Town P.S. Case No. 997 of 2022
